name: sticky-scroll-reveal

frames.best_why: First frame shows the full active heading and paragraph with no top clipping.

tagline: Text list scrolls beside a sticky gradient tile that swaps with each item.
summary: A scroll-driven feature section: paragraphs sit on the left while a sticky gradient tile on the right shows the matching visual. As you scroll, the active paragraph brightens and both the tile and the panel background change colour.
appearance: A dark panel split in two: a left column of bold white headings and small grey paragraphs, and a rounded square gradient tile on the right holding a centred label. The panel background is deep navy or near-black, and the tile shifts between green, purple and orange gradients.
behaviour: Scrolling the inner panel moves the text column past a sticky tile. The item nearest the top fades up to full opacity while the others dim, and the tile gradient plus the panel background switch to the next colour.
demo_content: Four items: Collaborative Editing, Real time changes, Version control, Running out of content.
search_phrases: text list beside sticky image on scroll
scroll through features with changing picture
section that switches picture as you scroll
highlight paragraph as user scrolls past
sticky panel that follows the text
use_when: A feature walkthrough where each paragraph needs its own visual and a change of mood while scrolling.
avoid_when: Fewer than four items: the fixed-height inner scroll leaves awkward empty space.
customise: Pass a content array of title, description and an optional visual node; colours, gradients and the inner panel height are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Text plus one sticky tile; work happens only while scrolling.

a11y.note: No list semantics or aria; inactive text sits at 30% opacity and the inner scroll area is not keyboard focusable.

issues: Inactive paragraphs render at 30% opacity on dark, hard to read.
The gradient tile is hidden below the lg breakpoint.
Later frames crop the top text mid-line.
polish_why: Clean two-column rhythm and a smooth colour shift; faded inactive copy is hard to read.
title: Sticky Scroll Reveal
